note: Read 2026-10-30 on gov.ai, the Government of Anguilla's site. Applicants must be at least 18 and pass the written test (EC$50.00) and the road test (EC$90.00), not held; a one-year Class B licence costs EC$125.00 and runs to 31 December of the year issued, a three-year one EC$310.00 and runs 3 years from issue; the three-year licence is held. The learner's permit (from 16, EC$65.00, 3 months) isn't held. Anguilla issues no identity card at this office.

sources.title: Government of Anguilla, Driving Licences & Permit
sources.said: Licences can be obtained at the Inland Revenue department ... Applicants must be atleast 18 years of age. ... The cost of a three (3) year licence (Class B) is $310.00 EC and it remains valid for 3 years after the date of issue
